applicabilityBasis.summary: cUSD targets dollar value and permits minting/burning at oracle value or proportional basket redemption. Those documented exits return backing digital assets and can transmit underlying depegs to redeemers. Public terms identify Covered Agents S.A. as platform operator but do not identify a legal obligor to redeem cUSD for fixed monetary value as required by GENIUS section 2(22). Stablecoin marketing and unresolved issuer/redemption rights support unclear applicability.

genius.notes: Cap documents oracle-value burning and proportional basket redemption into backing digital assets, including loss transmission when underlying assets depeg. Covered Agents S.A. is identified as a Panama website/platform operator, not expressly as the cUSD legal issuer or fixed-monetary-value redemption obligor; issuerEntity and domicile are therefore omitted. The cUSD reserves-dashboard URL opens, but its static response contains zero placeholders, so actual current reserve-data disclosure is not asserted. Documented token redemption does not establish a fixed 1:1 monetary-value redemption policy. No reserve/redemption/monthly-attestation booleans are asserted. The reopened named public-source review located no qualifying GENIUS authorization or U.S. token/operator enforcement action. Federal issuer proposals and SCRC procedural rules do not themselves qualify this token. DASP posture refers only to pre-effective GENIUS restrictions, not universal availability or lawfulness.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, reopened Cap operator terms and token/vault documentation, the complete OCC pending digital-asset licensing table, complete NYDFS regulated-entity table and issuance Greenlist, current federal proposals and SCRC procedure, exact-name Federal Register API searches and official-domain name searches did not identify a qualifying public GENIUS approval, state-qualified designation, official application or foreign registration for Cap cUSD, Cap Protocol or Covered Agents S.A. Cap Protocol returned three unrelated pre-2016 Federal Register records; Covered Agents returned four unrelated medical/Medicare records. No matching OCC or NYDFS entry was found. Public sources do not exclude confidential or unindexed filings. The operator is identified, but the token legal issuer and fixed-monetary-value redemption obligation remain unresolved.
